# STOP — DO NOT SUBMIT SENSITIVE SECURITY VULNERABILITIES IN PUBLIC ISSUES

If you have discovered a potential security vulnerability, credential bypass, or cryptographic defect in CredCloak, please report it privately:

1. **GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting**:
   Navigate to [Security Advisories](https://github.com/ayushdixit1-av/credcloak/security/advisories) and click **"Report a vulnerability"**.

2. **Direct Security Email**:
   Email: **`ayushdixitvsecpanki@gmail.com`**  
   Subject: `[SECURITY] CredCloak Vulnerability Report`

Please see [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/ayushdixit1-av/credcloak/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for full response timeline commitments.
